tripNotices.title: Food balance
tripNotices.body: Do not overdo bacalhau. Try one good cod preparation, then diversify across tinned fish, seafood, pork, rissóis, bifanas/francesinha, vegetables, and other regional dishes.

locations.name: Conserveira de Lisboa
locations.notes: Easy Baixa stop for quality Portuguese tinned fish. Friend recommends José Gourmet or Pinhais/Nuri; verify Sunday hours before relying on it.

locations.name: A Ginjinha
locations.notes: Quick Lisbon micro-stop: one small ginjinha, with or without the cherry.

locations.name: The Little Wine Bar
locations.notes: Friend favorite for a casual glass of wine on the steps. Keep as a nearby option rather than crossing town for it.

locations.name: Imprensa Cocktail & Oyster Bar
locations.notes: Preferred Sunday post-dinner cocktail option; friend specifically recommends the cocktails, oysters, and small bites.

locations.name: Red Frog
locations.notes: Excellent cocktail-bar backup if Imprensa is not the mood.

locations.name: Lumi Rooftop
locations.address: Rua de São Pedro de Alcântara 35, 1250-237 Lisboa
locations.notes: Primary Monday sunset-drink choice before Taberna; better fit for a seated, polished rooftop experience.

locations.name: Castro – Atelier de Pastéis de Nata
locations.notes: Excellent Chiado nata backup/comparison; use only if naturally nearby.

locations.name: Time Out Market Porto
locations.address: South Wing, São Bento Station, Praça de Almeida Garrett, Porto
locations.notes: Built into São Bento Station, so it costs almost no itinerary time; browse for 15–30 minutes rather than making it a destination meal.

locations.name: Cantina 32
locations.notes: Primary Tuesday dinner choice; convenient to the apartment and historic-center walk.

locations.name: Taberna dos Mercadores
locations.notes: Tuesday dinner backup; tiny and harder to secure.

locations.name: Oficina dos Rissóis
locations.notes: Flexible casual snack/light-lunch wildcard. Portuguese without committing another full meal.

locations.name: Café Santiago
locations.notes: Canonical francesinha option. Treat it as a taste: share one rather than sacrificing a whole meal.

locations.name: Taberna Folias de Baco
locations.notes: Preferred optional Wednesday post-Douro stop: natural wine and a small plate, only if everyone still wants to go out.

locations.name: SHIKO – Tasca Japonesa
locations.notes: Deliberate backup for the moment someone wants a break from Portuguese food.

locations.name: Sandeman Porto Cellars
locations.address: Largo Miguel Bombarda 3, Vila Nova de Gaia
locations.notes: If the group still wants a formal Port lodge Thursday, this is the easiest geographic fit. Do not force it after Bordeaux and the Douro.

locations.name: Torto
locations.notes: Optional first-night cocktail only if energy allows.

routes.label: Lumi Rooftop to Taberna – Bairro do Avillez

notes: Conserveira de Lisboa fits the Baixa-to-Alfama flow if it is open; verify Sunday hours same-day rather than detouring for it.
The Little Wine Bar is a strong backup but opens later and sits closer to Rossio/Chiado, so do not force it into the Alfama afternoon pause.

item.title: Walk Praça do Comércio / Baixa; optional Conserveira de Lisboa
item.description: Natural route toward the historic center. Pop in for quality tinned fish only if open; do not make a special detour.

insertItems.beforeTitle: Bolt toward Castelo de São Jorge if Tram 28 queue is long

item.title: Optional quick ginjinha
item.description: A ten-minute Lisbon ritual if the route and energy cooperate. One small glass, then keep moving.

replaceItems.matchTitle: Optional cocktail: Red Frog, Foxtrot, or Imprensa

item.title: Optional cocktail: Imprensa preferred; Red Frog backup
item.description: Friend specifically recommends Imprensa for cocktails, oysters, and small bites. Red Frog is the backup; skip both if dinner feels like enough.

notes: Castro on Rua Garrett is an excellent nata comparison if naturally nearby in Chiado; do not add it as another required food stop after the tour and Pastéis de Belém.

item.title: Lumi Rooftop
item.description: Primary sunset-drink choice before Taberna: better fit for four people who want a comfortable seat and polished rooftop atmosphere. Park Rooftop remains the backup.

notes: Time Out Market Porto is inside São Bento, so browse for 15–30 minutes if it looks interesting; do not turn it into a destination meal.
For a Porto specialty, share one francesinha at Café Santiago if timing and appetite line up. Oficina dos Rissóis is the lighter Portuguese wildcard; SHIKO is the non-Portuguese escape hatch.

item.title: São Bento + optional Time Out Market, Cathedral, Rua das Flores, Ribeira
item.description: Gentle arrival loop. Time Out Market is built into São Bento; browse briefly if appealing, then keep moving toward the Cathedral and river.

replaceItems.matchTitle: Dinner options: Cantina 32, Taberna dos Mercadores, Adega São Nicolau

item.title: Cantina 32
item.description: Primary Tuesday dinner choice because it fits the route and apartment location. Taberna dos Mercadores and Adega São Nicolau remain backups.

replaceItems.matchTitle: Optional cocktail: Torto or The Royal Cocktail Club

item.title: Optional cocktail: Torto; Royal Cocktail Club backup
item.description: Only if energy allows. Do not turn the first Porto evening into a late-night mission.

replaceItems.matchTitle: Light local bite only if hungry

item.title: Optional Folias de Baco if everyone still wants to go out
item.description: Natural wine and a small plate near the center. After a full Douro day, staying in is equally correct.

notes: A formal Port lodge is now optional rather than a priority after the Bordeaux week and full Douro day. If everyone still wants one, Sandeman is the simplest geographic choice.
If you see Quinta do Convento/Kranemann 20-year tawny on a list or in a shop, a repeat visitor strongly recommends it.

replaceItems.matchTitle: Choose no more than one optional activity

item.title: Choose one optional activity — or none
item.description: Port lodge only if everyone genuinely wants more wine; Sandeman is the easiest fit. Otherwise choose Lello/Clérigos, a river walk, or simply preserve energy for The Yeatman.
